description: Election Commission - Declare that D. M. S. Disanayaka was Elected as the Member of the Ipalogama Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government authority (Ipalogama Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of an elected member. It specifically operates under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and involves the nomination and declaration of a new elected member through a political party's decision. This content directly relates to electoral processes and local government member appointments, fitting the definition of Elections Gazettes (Type 7).
